newsitem.title: USA: Additional highlights of NYS Gov.'s revised budget.
newsitem.headline: Additional highlights of NYS Gov.'s revised budget.

text.p: Additional highlights of the revised budget proposed by New York State Gov George Pataki for fiscal 1998, which begins April 1, follow:

--Spending by various categories breaks down into General Funds at $32.9 billion, about $7 million under fiscal 1997. All Funds spending, which includes federal aid and grants, is estimated at $66.29 billion, a 2.4 percent rise. And State Fund spending is seen at $44.1 billion, a 1.5 percent increase.
--Another $38.4 million would be spent to accomodate an unexpected rise in Federal funding for the Federal Captial Projects Fund, which will mean the bonding program will fall by the same amount.
--The Dormitory Authority gets another $28 million to refinance outstanding Certificates of Participation.
